name: PR list Actions column: the Run Review dropdown opens without navigating the row
description: The PR list's new ACTIONS column holds a labelled 'Run Review ⌄' ghost-style trigger (highlights on hover) whose menu is portaled to document.body (the table card is overflow: hidden, which would otherwise clip it). Opening the menu must NOT fire the row's own navigation, and 'Configure agents…' must leave for /agents. Read-only: the flow only opens the menu and follows the Configure link — it never picks 'Run all enabled agents' or a specific agent, so no model call happens. NOTE: the 'Last synced' label next to Refresh is deliberately NOT asserted here — seed.ts leaves repos.last_polled_at NULL, so it only appears after a real Refresh, which would enqueue a live clone and break this flow's read-only contract (it is covered by FilterBar.test.tsx instead).
